query:
SELECT 
                        e.id,
                        e.name,
                        t.name as topic,
                        e.question,
                        e.truth,
                        e.affinity_days as "affinity_days: Option<u32>"
                    FROM entry as e
                    JOIN topic as t ON e.topic_id = t.id
                    WHERE t.id = ? AND e.is_reviewed = FALSE
                    ORDER BY RANDOM()
                    LIMIT 1
